label: mmq-256x2 / 128x8 / 64x8
note: other launch shapes: 97.8 / 95.0 / 94.7 ms at 16 rows, none better than 128x4

label: mmq-jmax40-bigocc2
note: skinny shape up to 40 rows, occupancy 2 up to 64

label: gpu-read-bandwidth
note: microbench gpu_read_bw.cu: best coalesced read 238-249 GB/s (u64, 40-160 blocks x 256-512 threads); u32 loads 149-191; chunked per-thread streams 100-207. Matmuls sit at ~185 GB/s

label: load-ahead-q4k-q6k
note: issue all qs/ql/qh loads of a tile into registers before first use: no change (93.8 ms at 16 rows), compiler already hoists or loads are not the limiter

label: next-tile-prefetch
note: one extra load per 64-byte line of tile k+1 kept in flight during compute of tile k: slower, extra loads compete with the real ones

note: skinny shape + MMVQ limit 3 for Q5_K, IQ4_XS, IQ4_NL, Q8_0 (UD mixes). UD-Q4_K_XL: 16 rows 114.8 -> 99.9, 8 rows 111.1 -> 93.5

label: blas-bf16-from-320-rows
note: large batches: dequantize + cuBLAS BF16 instead of MMQ. 512 rows 1234 -> 781 ms, 2048 rows 4932 -> 2182 ms; crossover at 256 rows; PPL 5.056 vs 5.061

note: Q4_K tile loader fetches 8 bytes per thread (2 rows per warp) instead of 4

label: q4k-load-16B
